supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:49 UTC, PowerShell ran on WS-MLOPEZ-01 as omar.haddad with the command line `-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1`, matching the documented IT workstation-patching procedure.
A network logon for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01 was recorded on WS-MLOPEZ-01 shortly before the PowerShell process started, consistent with the documented remote-administration source.
The PowerShell process launched wusa.exe to install a Windows 11 update package, and the proxy recorded a Windows Update download during the same activity.
PowerShell exited about 50 seconds after launch; the observed process chain and update activity are consistent with a brief patching operation rather than evidence of an unrelated PowerShell task.

known_telemetry_limitations: The records establish a PowerShell process and its command line, but do not directly establish whether a visible window appeared or what Maria saw.
The provided records do not include the contents or hash of Deploy-Patches.ps1 or the update package.
Winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable on WS-LPARK-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC; that outage is on a different host and does not establish missing telemetry on WS-MLOPEZ-01.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish whether Maria's reported time of about 13:40 was exact; the recorded PowerShell launch was at 13:41:49 UTC.
The evidence does not independently verify the script's contents, the update package's provenance, or whether this specific patch run had a corresponding change ticket.
The logs do not prove that a visible PowerShell window was displayed to the logged-in user.
unrelated_findings: A Google Drive File Stream user agent contacted clients4.google.com from WS-MLOPEZ-01. Google Drive is not among the approved services listed in the environment context; the records show contact, not that files were uploaded. Review separately. (T014-00218, T014-00219)

A Dropbox updater contacted desktop.dropbox.com from WS-MLOPEZ-01. Dropbox is not among the approved services listed in the environment context; the records show updater traffic, not file sharing. Review separately. (T014-00285, T014-00286)

WS-MLOPEZ-01 obtained a Kerberos ticket for ben.carter and a network logon as ben.carter was recorded on WS-BCARTER-01; later, DC-HD-01 recorded a network logon for maria.lopez with WS-BCARTER-01 as the workstation. This cross-host/account activity is outside the alerted PowerShell activity and merits separate review. (T014-00089, T014-00090, T014-00092, T014-00112)

A signed Palo Alto GlobalProtect process was launched on WS-MLOPEZ-01. The provided records show the process and a valid signature, but no VPN connection; review separately if this software's presence is unexpected. (T014-00071, T014-00072, T014-00073)
